title: KOMHTOM 3 Seater L-Shaped Sofa with 2 Drawers, Storage Stool, LED Lamp, USB/Type-C Port and Wooden Frame – Multifunctional Corduroy Sofa (Dark Grey, B)

It is wrinkle resistant, durable, and easy to care for, improving the comfort and visual quality of your living space

SOLID WOOD FRAME - Supported by a high quality solid wood frame, this sofa guarantees exceptional durability and structural integrity. This sturdy frame ensures safe and stable seating comfort for many years

USB/Type-C Port - Equipped with a 12V USB/Type-C port, this ergonomic sofa makes it easy to charge your electronic devices at any time. This meets your daily charging needs, providing extra convenience for you and your guests

QUICK AND EASY ASSEMBLY - This comfortable sofa is designed to be easy to assemble and comes with clear, step-by-step instructions that you can follow to complete assembly quickly. Due to the large size of this product, it is shipped in 3 packages and may arrive on different dates. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us
